records.source: Suspicious Guy: It'll just cost ya 1 Calico Egg. A small price to pay for the 'edge' you'll get.
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: 1 Itlog ng Calico lang ang halaga. Maliit na kabayaran para sa 'lamang' na makukuha mo.

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Need my 'services'? It'll just cost ya 1 Calico Egg.
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Kailangan mo ang 'serbisyo' ko? 1 Itlog ng Calico lang ang halaga.

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Alright, so who's gonna be the unlucky racer?
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Sige, sino ang magiging malas na mananakbo?

records.source: Suspicious Guy: Looks like you don't have any Calico Eggs, kid. Stop wastin' my time.
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Mukhang wala kang Itlog ng Calico, bata. Huwag mong sayangin ang oras ko.

records.source: Suspicious Guy: {0}, huh? You got it, kid.
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: {0}, ano? Sige, bata.

records.source: Suspicious Guy: {0} it is. Now excuse me, I've got a phone call to make...
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: Si {0} kung gayon. Paumanhin, may tatawagan ako...

records.source: Suspicious Guy: {0}? Sure, sure... Good luck, kid.
records.translation: Kahina-hinalang Lalaki: {0}? Sige, sige... Sana palarin ka, bata.

records.source: I'm still getting things set up. Why don't you check back later?
records.translation: Inaayos ko pa ang lahat. Bumalik ka na lang mamaya.

records.source: Looking to test your mettle, huh?#$b#I've got a few challenges that might do just that.
records.translation: Gusto mong subukin ang tibay mo, ano?#$b#May ilang hamon akong makagagawa niyan.

records.source: Feeling the adventurer's spirit?#$b#Good, here are today's challenges.
records.translation: Nararamdaman mo ba ang diwa ng pakikipagsapalaran?#$b#Mabuti, narito ang mga hamon ngayon.

records.source: I hope you've kept your weapons maintained.#$b#You'll need them in top form for today's challenges.
records.translation: Sana ay napanatili mong maayos ang mga sandata mo.#$b#Kailangan mong nasa pinakamahusay na kondisyon ang mga iyon para sa mga hamon ngayon.

records.source: I can see a bold look in your eye.#$b#How about a challenge?
records.translation: Nakikita ko ang matapang na tingin sa iyong mga mata.#$b#Gusto mo ng hamon?

records.source: Still working on the challenge, huh?#$b#Well, here it is, in case you needed a reminder.
records.translation: Ginagawa mo pa rin ang hamon, ano?#$b#Narito iyon kung kailangan mo ng paalala.

records.source: Very good.#$b#There'll be more challenges tomorrow, so take it easy and get some rest.
records.translation: Napakahusay.#$b#Marami pang hamon bukas, kaya magdahan-dahan at magpahinga.

records.source: Hey, you did it! I'm impressed.#$b#That's it for this year, but Gil and I will be here again next time around.
records.translation: Hoy, nagawa mo! Humahanga ako.#$b#Iyan na ang lahat ngayong taon, pero narito ulit kami ni Gil sa susunod.

records.source: It's a brand new day... come back when you've proven yourself in the caverns.
records.translation: Bagong araw ito... bumalik ka kapag napatunayan mo na ang sarili mo sa mga yungib.

records.source: That's it for this year... *snore*...
records.translation: Iyan na ang lahat ngayong taon... *hilik*...

records.source: That's it for today. You can try again tomorrow, if you're up for it... *snore*...
records.translation: Iyan na ang lahat ngayon. Maaari kang sumubok muli bukas kung handa ka... *hilik*...

records.source: Submit today's highest egg rating to Gil?^(Egg Rating {0})
records.translation: Ibigay kay Gil ang pinakamataas na Marka ng Itlog ngayon?^(Marka ng Itlog {0})

records.source: ...{0}? Hahahaha.... okay, kiddo. Here's a little prizey for you... now, go along and play with the other kids.
records.translation: ...{0}? Hahahaha.... sige, bata. Narito ang munting premyo mo... ngayon, makipaglaro ka na sa ibang mga bata.

records.source: ...{0}? That's not too impressive, but at least you had the gumption to try. Here's a little something.
records.translation: ...{0}? Hindi gaanong kahanga-hanga, pero kahit paano ay nagkalakas-loob kang sumubok. Narito ang kaunting bagay.

records.source: {0}, huh? Not bad, not bad... of course, when I was your age I was doin' twice that. With a Rusty Sword, and no food!
records.translation: {0}, ano? Hindi masama, hindi masama... siyempre, noong kasing-edad mo ako ay doble niyan ang nagagawa ko. Gamit ang Kinakalawang na Espada at walang pagkain!

records.source: {0}... that ain't bad at all. That's the kind of number we're looking for in the Adventurer's Guild. Here's your prize.
records.translation: {0}... talagang hindi masama. Ganyang bilang ang hinahanap namin sa Samahan ng mga Adventurer. Narito ang premyo mo.
records.englishResidueReason: Adventurer is retained in the canonical Filipino glossary's organization name.

records.source: {0}? Okay, now I'm impressed...#$b#Hey, Marlon! Get a load of this... an Egg Rating of {0} for the day!
records.translation: {0}? Sige, humahanga na ako...#$b#Hoy, Marlon! Tingnan mo ito... Marka ng Itlog na {0} ngayong araw!

records.source: {0}!?!#$b#Well, I'll be... We've got a real Calico Egg hunter here!
records.translation: {0}!?!#$b#Aba... May tunay tayong mangangaso ng Itlog ng Calico rito!

records.preserveReason: The player-facing value consists only of a preserved placeholder, punctuation, and an emotion token; there is no linguistic content to translate.

records.source: You hear a voice in your head: 'It would be dishonorable to submit an egg rating acquired through the use of cheat code software!'
records.translation: May narinig kang tinig sa iyong isip: 'Walang dangal ang pagsusumite ng Marka ng Itlog na nakuha gamit ang programang pandaya!'

records.source: Please return when an attendant is present.
records.translation: Bumalik ka kapag narito ang tagapag-ayos.

records.source: You're looking great!$h#$b#Come back another day and we'll put together a fresh new look for you!
records.translation: Napakaganda mo!$h#$b#Bumalik sa ibang araw at gagawan ka namin ng panibagong hitsura!

records.source: Not half bad, sweetie!$h#$b#Come back soon, I'll have a new look waiting for you!
records.translation: Hindi masama, mahal!$h#$b#Bumalik ka agad, may bagong hitsurang maghihintay sa iyo!

records.source: Hmm, your backpack's looking a little full. Come back when you've made enough room for a full set of clothes!
records.translation: Hmm, mukhang punô ang bag mo. Bumalik kapag may sapat ka nang puwang para sa isang buong set ng damit!

records.source: Hmm, your backpack's looking a little full. Come back when you've made enough room for a full set of clothes.
records.translation: Hmm, mukhang punô ang bag mo. Bumalik kapag may sapat ka nang puwang para sa isang buong set ng damit.

records.source: Okay, before we continue, let me visualize your aura, to see what kind of style will make you happiest...
records.translation: Sige, bago tayo magpatuloy, hayaan mong makita ko ang iyong aura upang malaman kung anong estilo ang lubos na magpapasaya sa iyo...

records.source: Yes... I see...
records.translation: Oo... nakikita ko...

records.source: Oops, sorry if that tickles.
records.translation: Ay, paumanhin kung nakakakiliti iyon.

records.source: Yikes, sorry if that hurt!
records.translation: Naku, paumanhin kung masakit iyon!

records.source: Whoa, that's way too much hair gel...
records.translation: Grabe, napakaraming gel sa buhok niyan...
records.englishResidueReason: Gel is a conventional Filipino cosmetic loanword.

records.source: No... this won't do...
records.translation: Hindi... hindi ito maaari...

records.source: Here, catch!
records.translation: Heto, saluhin mo!

records.source: Oh look, a cauliflower fritter...
records.translation: O, tingnan mo, pritong koliplor...
